S50U26.five_day_thesis: Spot is 12.6 points below the 1083.3 high of 09-09 and has converged onto an anchor that never moved: max pain 1070, call wall 1100 and the structural 910 put wall are all unchanged across the full window, so nothing migrated - the gamma distribution underneath them inverted instead. Put OI added 1,284 contracts against call OI -752, lifting P/C OI 2.26 to a window-high 2.42, but the character of that flow changed today: 235 lots of 1060 puts were closed to open 0.2-point tickets at 910 and 950 that carry null gamma, which is protection being cheapened, not deepened. ATM IV bottomed at 12.21% on 09-11, spiked to 13.41% on the 09-15 decline and settled back to 12.78% today - no IV expansion is confirming a break yet, which is what still keeps this a coiled setup rather than an active one. The five-day result is a pin that holds geometrically while the mechanism enforcing it has moved entirely above the market, stacking the acceleration risk below 1050 and capping anything above 1080.
